rows.ja: 競合(各社の資料に記載)

relations.text: 欧州のタクシー配車アプリを2025年7月に約2.35億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the European taxi app in July 2025 for about $235 million

source.label: Lyft 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 31, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of 100 % of the outstanding equity of Intelligent Apps GmbH (d/b/a Freenow), a European multimodal application with a taxi offering at its core

companies.name: TBRグローバル・ショーファーリング

relations.text: 2025年10月に高級ハイヤー会社を買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the premium chauffeur company in October 2025

source.label: Lyft 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 14, 2025, we completed the acquisition of TBR, a global premium ground transportation and chauffeur service company

relations.text: 自動運転車の需要側顧客の一社としてリフトを公表
relations.text_en: Names Lyft among announced demand-side customers for its self-driving systems

source.label: Mobileye 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: with announced demand-side customers including Deutsche Bahn, Beep, Holo / Ruter, Lyft and others.

companies.name: ウェルジスティクス・ヘルス

relations.text: 処方薬配送でリフトと提携
relations.text_en: Uses Lyft as a ride-sharing partner for prescription delivery

source.label: Wellgistics Health 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: third-party relationships with Wellgistics Health's national and regional ride- sharing partners (i.e., Lyft and Roadie) for prescription delivery

relations.text: リフトは米国・カナダの主な競合をウーバーとし、ウーバーもリフトを競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Lyft calls Uber its main ridesharing competitor; Uber lists Lyft among its rivals

source.label: Lyft 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our main ridesharing competitor in the U.S. and Canada is Uber, and in Europe, our main competitors for app-based intermediation services for taxi and private hire vehicles are Uber and Bolt

relations.text: ウーバーも競合の一社にリフトを挙げる
relations.text_en: Uber names Lyft among ridesharing companies it competes with

source.label: Uber 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We also compete with other ridesharing companies for Drivers and Riders, including Bolt, Didi, Grab, Lyft, and Ola.

relations.text: 欧州での主な競合にボルトを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Bolt as a main competitor in Europe

source.label: Lyft 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in Europe, our main competitors for app-based intermediation services for taxi and private hire vehicles are Uber and Bolt

companies.name: ヴィア・トランスポーテーション

relations.text: 大手移動サービスの競合にリフトを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Lyft among large mobility companies it competes with

source.label: Via Transportation 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: large technology and mobility 25 Table of Contents companies (such as Siemens Mobility, Mobileye (Moovit), Uber, Lyft, and Verizon)

companies.name: マーブルゲート・キャピタル

relations.text: タクシーはウーバー・リフトとの激しい競争に直面
relations.text_en: Says taxis face significant competition from Uber and Lyft

source.label: Marblegate Capital 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Taxis face significant competition from ridesharing companies such as Uber and Lyft, public transportation, personal vehicle ownership, and other for-hire vehicles

relations.text: 地上交通のリフトとも間接的に競合
relations.text_en: Competes indirectly with ground transport providers including Lyft

source.label: AIRO Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: as well as ground-based transportation providers, including Uber Technologies, Inc. and Lyft, Inc., to the extent our offerings overlap with certain passenger or logistics use cases.

companies.name: エンボイ・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: 競合にウーバー・リフトなど配車サービスを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Uber and Lyft among its competitors

source.label: Envoy Technologies S-1/A(2025年5月)
source.quote: car ride and limousine services like Uber and Lyft, traditional asset-heavy rental car companies such as Hertz and Avis Budget

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
